exams.title: Emergency Medical Specialist - EMT (Fire)
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify under this NOE.
exams.summary: Provide basic life support, emergency medical care, and ambulance transportation with FDNY.
exams.qualifications: A high school diploma or equivalent plus a valid New York State EMT-Basic or EMT-Paramedic certificate by the deadline stated in the NOE.
exams.test_method: See the NOE for every test part and deadline

exams.title: Emergency Medical Specialist Trainee
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify under this NOE.
exams.summary: Train with FDNY to become an emergency medical technician and serve patients across the city.
exams.qualifications: A high school diploma or equivalent plus one of the work, military, college-credit, or approved EMS-coursework paths listed in the NOE.
exams.test_method: See the NOE for every test part and deadline

exams.title: Assistant Civil Engineer
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, NYC high school students, first-time test takers, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify.
exams.summary: Help design, inspect, and supervise City construction and infrastructure work.
exams.qualifications: The NOE lists several paths, including a civil engineering degree plus experience or specified graduate study.
exams.amendment: The July 15 amended NOE extended the application deadline to August 25.

exams.title: Automotive Service Worker
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, NYC high school students, first-time test takers, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify.
exams.summary: Inspect, maintain, service, and help repair City cars, trucks, and other vehicles.
exams.qualifications: Two years of automotive maintenance experience, relevant trade or technical education, an associate degree in automotive technology, or an allowed combination.
exams.amendment: The July 15 amended NOE extended the application deadline to August 25.

exams.title: Caseworker
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, NYC high school students, first-time test takers, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify.
exams.summary: Connect New Yorkers with public benefits, health care, housing, and other social services.
exams.qualifications: A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.

exams.title: Caseworker (NYC Health + Hospitals)
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, NYC high school students, first-time test takers, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify.
exams.summary: Help hospital patients and families connect with benefits, care, housing, and social services.
exams.qualifications: A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.

exams.title: School Safety Agent
exams.fee_waiver: Veterans, unemployed applicants, NYC high school students, first-time test takers, and applicants receiving public assistance or Supplemental Security Income may qualify.
exams.salary_note: Current minimum annual salary; the NOE lists increases through five years
exams.summary: Help keep public school buildings safe, assist visitors and students, and respond to incidents.
exams.qualifications: A high school diploma or equivalent. The NOE also lists age, citizenship, residency, screening, and appointment requirements.
exams.test_method: Multiple-choice testing is expected to begin October 20, 2026

exams.title: Traffic Enforcement Agent
exams.fee_waiver: No application fee is charged for this exam.
exams.salary_note: Current minimum annual salary for Assignment Level II
exams.summary: Enforce parking and traffic rules and help keep vehicles and pedestrians moving safely.
exams.qualifications: A high school diploma or equivalent, plus the license, medical, psychological, and screening requirements in the NOE.
exams.test_method: Multiple-choice testing is expected to begin October 22, 2026
